name: io.quantumdev/site
title: QDev
description: Quantum computers and whether each is online, quantum events, and pages from quantumdev.io.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: The places that have upcoming quantum computing events: continents, countries, states where a country is searched by state, and cities, each with its number of events. Use the codes or names it returns as filters for list_events.

continent.description: Only this continent: its code (EU, NA, AS, OC, SA, AF) or its name.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Upcoming quantum computing events, soonest first, as summaries. Every filter is optional and they combine. Events are run by their own organisers; QDev checks each against its organiser's page. At most 50 a call; pass nextCursor back as cursor for more.

country.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (DE) or a country name (Germany).

region.description: A state or province, by ISO 3166-2 code (US-NV) or name (Nevada). Only some countries are searched by state.

from.description: Only events with a day on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: Only events with a day on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tag.description: A subject tag, such as quantum, research or industry.

text.description: Words to look for in the title, summary, place, venue and tags. Every word must match.

limit.description: How many to return. 20 when left out.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous call with the same filters.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event in full: dates, time zone, venue and place, summary, what is not yet settled, deadlines, the organiser's page, its page on quantumdev.io, and the date QDev last checked it.

id.description: The event's id, from list_events or search.

tools.name: get_event_calendar
tools.description: One event as an iCalendar (.ics) file, ready to add to a calendar. Returns the file's name, media type and text.

id.description: The event's id, from list_events or search.

tools.name: list_qpus
tools.description: The quantum computers reachable through the cloud that QDev's directory lists, with simulators and retired machines: each one's provider, technology, qubit count, region and status. A status is the provider's own word as of the time in asOf; say "as of" that time, since it can change by the minute. A machine not read for over an hour has the status "unconfirmed", never "online". Every filter is optional and they combine. Free. QDev is not affiliated with the providers.

status.description: Only machines with this status: online (running work), paused (accepting work but not running it for now), offline (not accepting work), retired (no longer offered) or unconfirmed (not read for over an hour).

kind.description: qpu for quantum computers, simulator for software that imitates one.

technology.description: How the qubits are made: trapped ion, superconducting, neutral atom, photonic or quantum annealer.

provider.description: Who makes the machine, such as IonQ, IQM, Rigetti or QuEra.

region.description: The AWS Region that serves the machine, such as us-east-1.

text.description: Words to look for in the name, provider, technology, region, place and the provider's summary. Every word must match.

tools.name: get_qpu
tools.description: One machine in full: what it is, its status with the time it was read and what that status means, its qubit count, how its qubits connect, its native operations, the hours it runs work and when they next open or close, what is waiting in its queues, its region and place, the provider's own summary and page, and its page on quantumdev.io. Where QDev has published a note on what that kind of machine suits, it comes too, as qdevNote: QDev's own writing, with a source for every claim, and never the provider's. Free.

id.description: The machine's id, from list_qpus or search, such as iqm-garnet.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Every public page and blog post on quantumdev.io: id, title, address, description and date. Use get_document for the text of one.

type.description: Only pages, or only blog posts.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: One page or blog post of quantumdev.io as markdown, with its title, address and date. Pages include the home page (what QDev is and its products), the privacy policy and the terms.

id.description: The document's id from list_documents or search (page:/privacy/, post:<slug>), or its address on quantumdev.io.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the events, the quantum computers, the pages and the blog posts of quantumdev.io by text. Returns matching results, best first, each with an id to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one search result, by its id: an event written out with its dates, place, deadlines and links, a quantum computer written out with its status and facts, or a page or post as markdown.

id.description: An id returned by search (event:<id>, qpu:<id>, page:<path>, post:<slug>).

tools.name: join_email_list
tools.description: Starts a sign-up to QDev's email list for a person who asked to join. QDev emails that address a confirmation link, and the address joins the list only when its owner opens the email and presses Confirm. Before calling, show the person this text and get their yes: "One email when each product opens and when an event is announced, and nothing else. Every one has a one-click unsubscribe link. Sent by QDev Inc., 675 Sturdivant Drive, Clarksville, TN 37042, info@quantumdev.io. Privacy Policy: https://quantumdev.io/privacy/#email-list"

agreed.description: True only when the person has been shown the text in this tool's description and has said yes to it.
